name: contact-find-duplicates
description: Weekly contacts dedup scan. Merges pairs with structural proof itself (when the autonomy score allows), files one Curia-owned review task per remaining pair above the score threshold, closes review tasks that are already settled, and returns summary counts, never a raw pair list. Skips pairs with an open review task, a recorded exclusion, or a review closed in the last 8 weeks unless a contact changed since.

outputs.auto_merge_disabled_reason: string? — why auto-merge was off this run
outputs.filed_for_principal: number — of filed, how many the principal may be asked about
